stem: Ana is painting one wall of her room. The wall is a rectangle 4 meters wide and 3 meters tall. It has a rectangular window that is 1.2 meters wide and 1 meter tall, which will not be painted. How many square meters of the wall will Ana paint?
solution: Area of the wall: \(4 \cdot 3 = 12\) square meters.
Area of the window: \(1.2 \cdot 1 = 1.2\) square meters.
verify:
ans=4*3-Rational('1.2')*1
assert ans==Rational(54,5)
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans and len(spr_answers)==1
